name: find_airport
description: Airports and cities matching a name or code; a city with several airports also comes as all of its airports

query.description: A city or airport name, or a code

name: search_flights
description: Search United flights. For a round trip it lists the outbound flights, each priced as the whole round trip; after the traveler picks an outbound fare, return_flights lists the returns. Prices include taxes and fees, for all travelers.

from.description: Airport code, or a city's all-airports name from find_airport

to.description: Airport code, or a city's all-airports name from find_airport

cabin.description: economy, or business_or_first (United's premium search: Polaris business, first and Premium Plus).

sortBy.description: best is United's own order; the others sort every option United returned

name: return_flights
description: The return flights for a round trip, after the traveler picked an outbound fare, each priced as the whole round trip with it

fareId.description: The outbound fare the traveler picked, from search_flights

name: fare_details
description: What each fare on one flight includes, such as checked bags, carry-on, change fees, refunds, seat choice and lounge access

flightId.description: A flight option from search_flights or return_flights

name: fare_calendar
description: The lowest fare for each date around the ones asked (round trip pairs, or one-way dates), to find cheaper days

from.description: Airport or city code (SHA for all of Shanghai)

cabin.description: economy, or business_or_first (United's premium search: Polaris business, first and Premium Plus).

name: get_miles_balance
description: The traveler's MileagePlus balance, from their signed-in United account; redeemable miles, lifetime miles, PlusPoints and TravelBank dollars

name: get_miles_activity
description: The traveler's recent MileagePlus activity, newest first, from their signed-in United account; what earned or spent miles, and how many

count.description: How many of the newest activities to list; 10 if left out
